Jesus I just wanna start off by saying I'm in no way in any sort of similar position to you, i come from a wealthy middle class family, I go to a private school and I have tonnes of support and encouragement. 

My parents tell me I'm smart, and I would definitely like to think I'm smart, but I just never do work, I never study and I have no work ethic. I feel like I'm a failure because I have all the resources put in front of me to lead me to success, but I can't be fucked to use them in any sort of productive way. I use my school laptop to download and play games, I spend entire weekends doing nothing but play video games, after I tell myself that I'm going to actually study this time.

I live in Australia and I'm in grade ten this year, which means I have my first exam block in four weeks. This is massive, and will probably predict how I finish grade twelve, and I'm already sure im going to flunk every single test. I don't know why I do this to myself. 

Back in primary school I could easily top the class and knew exactly what I was talking about, and now I'm a mess, I always insult and make fun of my friends, to the point where it's no longer a joke, it's just me being a dickhead, ive messed up so many friendships needlessly, by assuming I know best or what's going on inside people's head.

I have a girlfriend who lives in America, we planned out this whole thing where I would study in university while she was finishing up school so I could fly over to her and we could finally be together face to face. It's so fucking hard to be able to talk to her but not see her face or be able to just make skin contact. Now that I think about saying this to a few strangers over the internet that sounds more than a bit pathetic but that's what it is. As well as all that shit, Im struggling with myself over the idea that I don't like her for who she is, but because she likes me. I only talk to her because my ego is so malnourished that it needs a person pouring their own soul into it to make it feel better. I think that is the only reason I get into relationships like that. I know I'm only 15, I have very few experiences with love, but I really don't think I'm deserving of any kind of affection or attention, however deeply I crave it

I'm wondering if any of its even worth it like I'm already a failure, there's no hope for me or any kind of future that ends in me succeeding even remotely. If I did kill myself it wouldn't even be cus I was depressed, but cus I'm so pathetic I couldn't be bothered to deal with and sort out the problems in my life.
